suggestions.pitch: Trade surplus QBs Shough and Mills (neither starts for me) to a rebuilding team for Breece Hall and Stefon Diggs, two weekly starters.
Brissett and Shough are bench QBs for me, and they bring back Saquon Barkley plus Bucky Irving to a team at 3-3 that needs a quarterback.
Cousins and Bryant are idle on my bench, and Diggs plus Knight would add real starter points from a rebuilding partner.
